subject: Renewal package: term swap, pro-rated seat uplift, and MSA clarification
messages:
From: Sarah Lambert <sarah.lambert@teknova.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@teknova.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal inquiry — term and seat changes

Hi Rafael,

We're in the final stretch to close our renewal for the 7/1 start date. A few items legal/procurement want clarified before we sign:

- TekNova would like to move to a 24‑month term instead of 12 and have the pricing pro‑rated for Q3 seats.
- We want to consolidate two seat tiers into a single enterprise seat bucket (moving 120 seats into the new tier).
- Our legal team redlined the MSA and attached a doc — they prefer the retention period change and a small indemnity tweak.

Attaching: TekNova_MSA_redline_v1.docx (internal). Can your team confirm the impact on unit economics and if Redwood can accept the term swap + consolidation? Procurement is ready to route once we resolve the MSA items.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lambert
Head of Procurement, TekNova

Attachments: TekNova_MSA_redline_v1.docx
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lambert <sarah.lambert@teknova.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — term and seat changes

Sarah — thanks for the clear summary. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Commercial: term swap (12 -> 24 months) is feasible but we need to confirm pricing cadence and proration on the uplift. My estimate: blended effective price will move ~6–8% depending on how we treat the mid‑term seat add. I asked Ben to produce an updated order form.
- Legal/MSA: adding Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (contracts ops) to loop to resolve the redline. Kimberly — can you review TekNova's changes (they flagged data retention from 3 months -> 6 months and a limited indemnity carve‑out) and propose carve language or a counter-redline by EOD Monday?

I'll upload a scoped order form with proposed seat consolidation and proration for Q3. Please note we will require the standard usage audit clause and a one‑time onboarding credit if they want immediate burst capacity beyond the consolidated seats.

Best,
Rafael
Commercial Lead — West
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will attach OrderForm_TekNova_2028_Q3.xlsx in follow-up)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jun 2028 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: TekNova MSA redline review

Team — I reviewed TekNova_MSA_redline_v1 and prepared a tracked counter (attached as TekNova_MSA_redline_v2.docx). High level: 

1) Retention period: we can agree to 6 months for session-level telemetry but need to keep customer data retention to 90 days except where regulated. Proposed language: "Redwood will retain session telemetry up to 180 days for troubleshooting; customer PII and model inputs will be retained for a maximum of 90 days unless otherwise required by law."

2) Indemnity: TekNova's redline broadens their reverse indemnity. We will not accept open-ended indemnity. Proposed carve: limit to third‑party claims arising from TekNova's breach or misuse.

3) Term swap: legal has no objection to extending to 24 months; however, termination for convenience needs a 90‑day notice with pro‑rated billing.

I've inline‑commented the doc. Marissa — can you coordinate final order form pricing and confirm whether the onboarding credit Miguel requested can be absorbed in the Q3 proration? Ben — please run the price impact scenario and add to the order form.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: TekNova_MSA_redline_v2.docx
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TekNova MSA redline review — pricing scenarios

Quick price runs attached. Summary:

- Option A (24 months, seat consolidation with pro‑rata billed immediately): effective blended ARR grows by ~7.2%. One‑time onboarding credit of $25k eats ~0.8% of uplift.
- Option B (24 months, deferred proration until next invoice quarter): blended ARR +5.9%, but procurement will likely push for immediate recognition.
- Option C (12 months backstop with 24‑month preferred term): commercial prefers 24 with 90‑day early termination pro‑rata clause to protect revenue.

I've populated OrderForm_TekNova_2028_Q3.xlsx with option A as the recommended path and added line items for the onboarding credit and monitoring SKU. Rafael — if you want I can mark red the cells we expect Procurement to challenge.

-Ben
Revenue Ops

Attachments: OrderForm_TekNova_2028_Q3.xlsx
From: Sarah Lambert <sarah.lambert@teknova.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@teknova.com, legal@teknova.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — term and seat changes

Rafael / Kim / Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. TekNova legal reviewed your TekNova_MSA_redline_v2.docx and has two narrow asks: 

1) Can Redwood accept the 6‑month telemetry retention but formalize a data access audit window for TekNova (TekNova can request retention logs once per 12 months)?
2) Procurement asks that onboarding credit be reflected as a separate line item on the order form rather than a hidden discount.

We can sign once those two points are confirmed. Also please circulate the DocuSign packet when final.

Next steps requested from Redwood: send the final redline (MSA) and a clean order form with the onboarding credit line item. If we get both by EOD Wednesday, TekNova will commit to sign by Friday and schedule the 7/1 provisioning.

Regards,
Sarah
Head of Procurement, TekNova Inc.
